items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Marty Kay opened up Basin Street; Interviewee corrects the street number but does not claim a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: Yeah the bandstand was up over the bar.
Now were you working with Louie when he played the original Basin Street? Marty Kay opened up Basin Street, before Basin Street East. It was down on 50th Street.
